card.name: Supreme Court cases being heard
card.fires_on: Words in news text about the US Supreme Court hearing or deciding a case, such as 'hear the', 'the justices', 'petitioners', 'in the court'. Mostly civil-rights and affirmative-action stories.

modes.label: After 'hear'
modes.description: Small word right after the court 'will hear' or 'hears' a case.
modes.example: Next term, the Court will hear<< the>> case of Fisher v. University of Texas

modes.label: Court actors
modes.description: Words naming the court's participants, such as petitioners or justices.
modes.example: In Gratz, the two<< petition>>ers Jennifer Gratz and Patrick Hamacher

modes.label: Court proceedings
modes.description: Words about a question being brought before the court.
modes.example: In 2009, the court was<< presented>> with this same question.

card.plain: It marks news passages about the Supreme Court taking up or deciding a case.
